reason: Saturdays are my only real kid time and a clean, never-crowded place where I can sit with a coffee beats the germy chaos of other options. I'd use the free visit, and if it's as calm as promised I'd pay for a couple of Saturdays.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and I only get weekends, so $15 plus the trip every Saturday starts to feel like a lot.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it is really close to me or that the weekend visit was a bit cheaper or covered by a pack I can use across weekends; if the first visit is crowded or not actually clean I'm out.
